pages.title: Farm Triple Match 2
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Farm Triple Match 2 combines tile clearing with developing a farm. Select uncovered tiles and collect three identical ones in the bottom row to remove them. Complete boards to transform the empty field with animals, garden features, and additional farm content.

pages.title: Grow a garden for Brainrots
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Grow a garden for Brainrots lets you plant seeds and harvest unusual meme creatures. Improve your growing beds, gain levels, and open additional sections of the garden. Build the collection by continuing to cultivate seeds and discover rarer Brainrots.

pages.title: Steal A Fish
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Steal A Fish sends you into an underwater world to take valuable fish and escape with them. Sneak through the sea, catch a target, and move away before danger arrives. Deeper areas offer more valuable finds alongside greater risks to the expedition.

pages.title: Hopnova
pages.creator: Actibands minijuegos
pages.description: Hopnova challenges you to guide an explorer upward across floating platforms. Steer between landings, avoid dangers, and collect power-ups that help the climb continue. Reach greater heights and try to improve your best score during each vertical adventure.

pages.title: Magic Bottles
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Magic Bottles asks you to separate mixed liquids until every bottle holds one color. Move a top layer into an empty bottle or onto a matching color. Plan the transfers around different bottle types and increasingly complicated sorting arrangements.

pages.title: Billiard Diamond Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Billiard Diamond Challenge tasks you with pocketing every ball except the white cue ball. Aim carefully in either level-based or timed play, while collecting blue diamonds during the game. Use those diamonds to unlock another cue for future billiards challenges.

pages.title: DayCare Tycoon
pages.creator: Geniteam
pages.description: DayCare Tycoon puts you in charge of a growing childcare business. Welcome babies and handle the care activities needed to keep the daycare operating. Manage the space and its service tasks as you develop the business around looking after its young visitors.

pages.title: 2048 Match Balls
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: 2048 Match Balls combines aiming with number merging. Shoot a numbered ball toward another showing the same value to create a larger one. Keep combining matching numbers as their colors and sizes change, working toward producing a ball worth 2048.

pages.title: Stickman vs Zombies: Epic Fight
pages.creator: Valent
pages.description: Stickman vs Zombies: Epic Fight sends a red stick figure into a block-world apocalypse. Run, jump, dash, and chain sword attacks against zombies and other enemies. Defeat the opponents in each platforming area and move toward the next doorway.

pages.title: Pumpkin Patch
pages.creator: BobiBobi - Gry dla dzieci. Marcin Kustal
pages.description: Pumpkin Patch tests your ability to remember a pumpkin's appearance. Study the first character, then advance to a group of pumpkins and identify the matching one. Pay attention to its shape and other details so similar-looking alternatives do not mislead you.

pages.title: Mermaidcore Aesthetics
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Mermaidcore Aesthetics gives you three fashion characters with undersea-inspired wardrobes. Choose clothing and accessories to create a different mermaid-themed look for each one. Explore the individual selections and combine pieces into complete outfits for the trio's underwater fashion session.

pages.title: Drawer Sort
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Drawer Sort challenges you to turn cluttered drawers into organized spaces. Choose positions for the available objects and plan how everything will fit inside. Complete each arrangement by giving the items a suitable place rather than leaving the drawer more crowded.

pages.title: Hyper Survive
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Hyper Survive puts you a year into a zombie apocalypse with a camp to build and defend. Move around gathering what you need for survival and prepare for attacking waves. Develop your strategy around strengthening the camp and fighting off the undead.

pages.title: Mine & Slash
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Mine & Slash sends a miner into a three-dimensional roguelike dungeon for gold and resources. Direct the character while mining and attacks happen automatically. Explore deeper passages, gather valuable materials, and unlock stronger skills to support the continuing underground adventure.

pages.title: Delicious Emilys New Beginning Valentines Edition
pages.creator: Gamehouse
pages.description: Delicious Emilys New Beginning Valentines Edition combines restaurant time management with a romantic seasonal story. Help Emily serve dishes while balancing her culinary work and personal life. Complete the service challenges as the Valentine's storyline unfolds around the restaurant's busy routine.

pages.title: Find the Differences Winter
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Find the Differences Winter challenges you to compare pictures and mark the details that do not match. Search each scene carefully while watching the allotted time. Find the required differences before the countdown ends to complete the current visual puzzle.

pages.title: Toy Match
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Toy Match is a match-three puzzle in which you swap colored pieces into rows. Clear groups of at least three and plan combinations that improve the score. Meet the level's goals and earn more stars by choosing efficient moves across the toy-themed board.

pages.title: Fat Race 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fat Race 3D has you guide a character through a parkour course while choosing food pickups. Collect food to increase size and strength for overcoming obstacles. Steer between the available items and use the resulting physique to push through the route's challenges.

pages.title: Knock Em All
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Knock Em All challenges you to shoot approaching dummies and reach the final platform. Eliminate targets with headshots or knock them out of the building by hitting their bodies. Clear every dummy in the way to complete the shooting course.

pages.title: Gun War Z2
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Gun War Z2 puts you on a rescue mission during a zombie takeover. Shoot threats to escort people toward the airfield and evacuate them to safety. Aim explosives carefully, since rockets and exploding barrels can also injure the civilians you need to save.

pages.title: Boboiboy Galaxy Run
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Boboiboy Galaxy Run sends the hero through a running adventure to protect the Power Spheres. Jump, attack, and use character abilities against the villains along the route. Unlock additional heroes to bring different powers into the fight to save the galaxy.

pages.title: Master of Donuts
pages.creator: Umbukuu
pages.description: Master of Donuts asks you to sort stacks of pastries by their topping colors. Move the donuts between piles until matching varieties sit together. Plan the order of transfers so each stack becomes a single matching group without leaving useful pieces trapped.

pages.title: Metal Black Wars
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Metal Black Wars begins with a helicopter arrival before you fight an enemy army occupying the city. Run, jump, shoot, and throw bombs as you push back the attackers. Collect gold for stronger weapons and use healing when the battle wears you down.

pages.title: Move the Blocks
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Move the Blocks guides a cube along a road toward the stage's endpoint. Direct its movement to collect the points placed along the route and pass through color-changing sections. Reach the destination quickly to finish the level and open the next journey.

pages.title: Fashion Style Run 3D
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Fashion Style Run 3D asks you to guide a runner along a track collecting money-making items. Choose a path that gathers the valuables and improves the character's wealth. Reach the finish where a luxury car waits as the course's final attraction.

pages.title: Fallingman.io
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Fallingman.io puts you among twenty competitors across three different trials. Run and jump through the opening race to place ahead of the crowd, then face the later survival challenges. Keep meeting each round's requirements to remain in the competition.

pages.title: Boxie Space Jump
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Boxie Space Jump follows a small box-shaped traveler trying to get farther through space. Use clicks or taps to help Boxie continue the journey and collect bonuses along the way. Extend each attempt as you work toward a greater travel distance.

pages.title: Grand Bank: Robbery Duel
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Grand Bank: Robbery Duel is a shooting puzzle about firing when your weapon's red aiming line reaches the opponent. Time the trigger pull across more than twenty stages. Spend earned money on improvements to your character and gun between robbery-themed duels.

pages.title: Delivery Racer
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Delivery Racer sends a courier through busy roads at high speed. Overtake cars, avoid pedestrians and obstacles, and jump over moving vehicles when needed. Collect coins for new skins while using the delivery action to drop orders along the route.

pages.title: Neon Snake Game
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Neon Snake Game asks you to steer a glowing snake toward food to increase its score and length. Change direction with keyboard controls or finger swipes as it moves. Keep the growing body under control while working toward a new best total.

pages.title: Bridge Control
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Bridge Control asks you to slide an already-built bridge into a narrow opening between blocks. Move it left or right until its red supports line up with the marked grooves. React quickly enough to fit the bridge into the approaching gap.

pages.title: Angela All Season Fashion
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Angela All Season Fashion lets you create outfits for Angela across seasonal wardrobe sessions. Choose dresses, hairstyles, and accessories to match each part of the year. Work through the styling choices to give her a complete collection of seasonal looks.

pages.title: Police Car Drive
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Police Car Drive sends a patrol vehicle racing through traffic toward the end of a course. Steer past other cars while gathering cash and power-ups along the road. Keep the police car moving safely through the busy route to finish the track.

pages.title: Red and Blue Adventure 2
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Red and Blue Adventure 2 gives two characters ten stages of monsters and platforming challenges. Move and double-jump through each layout while collecting diamonds. Guide the pair toward the doorway and finish every level to complete the second adventure.

pages.title: Zombies Jump
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Zombies Jump challenges you to climb platforms while fighting the undead. Collect ammunition and shoot zombies when you can, or jump over them if your weapon is empty. Avoid physical contact with the enemies while trying to reach higher platforms.

pages.title: Perfect Salon
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Perfect Salon lets you create makeup looks for a range of customers. Change lipstick, eyeliner, and powder colors to suit each makeover and complete the styling task. Receive rewards and see the customers' reactions as you finish their new appearances.

pages.title: Spring Illustration Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Spring Illustration Puzzle offers nine seasonal pictures with four jigsaw difficulties per image. Select a layout from sixteen to one hundred pieces and reconstruct the chosen illustration. Match the scattered sections until the complete spring scene is back in place.

pages.title: Dunk Fall
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Dunk Fall challenges you to send a basketball through a hoop while it swings from a moving rope. Wait for a useful position, then tap or click to release the shot. Time each attempt so the ball's motion carries it toward the basket.

pages.title: Emma And Snowman Christmas
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Emma And Snowman Christmas combines snowman decorating with dressing Princess Emma for the holiday. Choose details for the snowy figure, then select clothing and accessories for Emma. Finish both festive looks to complete the Christmas preparation scene.

pages.title: Montezuma Gems
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Montezuma Gems combines gem matching with battles against ancient warriors guarding treasure. Form groups of at least three matching gems to strike the opponents. Complete the timed challenges by choosing useful combinations as you work toward the hidden riches.

pages.title: Flappy Dragon
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Flappy Dragon asks you to keep a dragon airborne while passing obstacles. Tap to control its height and adjust the rhythm of the flight as hazards approach. Avoid collisions and keep the dragon moving through the course for as long as possible.

pages.title: Traffic Driver
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Traffic Driver challenges you to keep a car moving through a crowded road without crashing. Steer past the surrounding vehicles and look for openings in the traffic. Continue overtaking cars safely to extend the drive through the busy route.

pages.title: Candy Color
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Candy Color asks you to rotate a multicolored circle so its sections line up with incoming candy. Tap to turn the ring and bring the matching colors together. Keep adjusting its orientation as the next sweet approaches the circular target.

pages.title: Fire Brigade
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fire Brigade puts you in charge of a fire truck responding to rescue calls. Drive to the required destination before time runs out and help the people there. Improve your abilities between jobs to strengthen the emergency crew's performance in later missions.

pages.title: Play Football
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description: Play Football challenges you to shoot a ball between another player's legs. Judge the changing angle and click when the shot lines up with the gap. The action speeds up over time, giving you less room to time each successful kick.

pages.title: Off Road Uphill Passenger Bus Driver 2k20
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Off Road Uphill Passenger Bus Driver 2k20 puts you behind the wheel of a bus on mountain roads. Guide the large vehicle through the hill-driving missions and control its speed through bends. Complete the assigned routes while handling the demanding off-road setting.

pages.title: Lego Trucks Coloring
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Lego Trucks Coloring offers sixteen truck illustrations to decorate. Choose a vehicle picture and apply your preferred colors to its different sections. Build a complete color scheme across the Lego-style truck drawing and continue to another image when the artwork is finished.

pages.title: Draw Dunk
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Draw Dunk challenges you to guide a thrown basketball into a blue box by drawing its route. Sketch a line that will help the ball reach the target. Work out how the path should direct its movement to solve the current puzzle.

pages.title: Fluffy Story 2
pages.creator: ALMA Games
pages.description: Fluffy Story 2 challenges you to reunite two small creatures separated by physical barriers. Cut their supporting ropes in the right order to change how they move through the scene. Guide the pair toward one another to complete the romantic puzzle.

pages.title: Dogs Connect Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Dogs Connect Deluxe asks you to remove pairs of identical dog tiles from a board. Connect each pair using no more than three straight line segments. Search for clear routes between matching pictures until every tile has been eliminated.

pages.title: Kunai Master
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Kunai Master tests your aim against boards descending toward the play area. Throw knives to destroy them, remembering that some targets require several hits. Time each launch to connect with the moving boards and improve the total from your attempt.

pages.title: Animal Go Racing
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Animal Go Racing puts you against other animals on a racing course. Jump over the route's challenges and activate skills to help your competitor move ahead. Improve speed and choose useful abilities as you work toward winning the animal races.

pages.title: Desert Kissing
pages.creator: Gamer Games
pages.description: Desert Kissing follows a honeymoon couple trying to share kisses during their desert trip. Begin kissing when the surroundings are safe, then stop when someone looks their way. Watch the other characters and use the available time to complete the kissing challenge.

pages.title: SeasonLand
pages.creator: Bubble Shooter
pages.description: SeasonLand follows Bunny Bot through a pixel-art platforming journey in search of an exit. Move between platforms, drop through surfaces when needed, and fight the enemies ahead. Watch for monsters and lethal traps while finding a route out of each area.

pages.title: Rush Crash Racing
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Rush Crash Racing challenges you to keep a car moving through traffic by changing lanes. Shift left or right to avoid vehicles blocking the route, and swipe upward to gain speed. React to the traffic ahead so the drive continues without a collision.

pages.title: Wedding battle Classic vs Modern
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Wedding battle Classic vs Modern puts two couples in competing wedding styles. Dress one pair in traditional bridal fashion and the other in a more unconventional look. Compare veils, gowns, and accessories as you prepare the classic and modern wedding entries.

pages.title: Cut it Fair
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Cut it Fair asks you to slice fruit into portions that suit the glasses shown. Drag the knife through the fruit and judge where each cut should go. Complete the stage by dividing the available fruit according to the target containers.

pages.title: Christmas Match 3
pages.creator: BrainGameStudios
pages.description: Christmas Match 3 gives you a holiday board of sweets to swap and combine. Form rows of at least three matching candies to remove them, then use earned power-ups for larger clears. Keep making useful matches to clear the festive arrangement quickly.

pages.title: Airplane Flight 3D Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Airplane Flight 3D Simulator puts you in control of an aircraft's takeoff, steering, throttle, and landing. Adjust power to get airborne and guide the plane through the flight. Practice the controls as you work toward bringing the aircraft down safely again.

pages.title: Throw Ball in the Hole
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Throw Ball in the Hole challenges you to place balls into their matching target containers. Aim each attempt so the ball reaches the required hole or bucket. When several colors appear, make sure every ball lands in the container assigned to it.

pages.title: Snowball Fight
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Snowball Fight lets you throw snowballs at other children while keeping enough ammunition ready. Reload when the supply runs low and react to opponents who become quicker and harder to hit. Face boss encounters as the winter battles grow more demanding.

pages.title: Animal Daycare Pet Vet
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Animal Daycare Pet Vet offers animal-care and grooming minigames. Look after pets through the available veterinary and styling activities, helping cats and dogs with their needs. Work through the care levels as you try the different roles within the pet daycare.

pages.title: Superhero Tower
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Superhero Tower challenges you to build a stack by timing when falling blocks are released. Place each section as accurately as possible to complete the tower. Work through one hundred levels, with better alignment contributing to the stage's star rating.

pages.title: Western Cowboy Run
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Western Cowboy Run sends you into a town overrun by zombies. Keep moving through an endless shooting challenge while cutting down the waves of undead. Use the available controls to continue the cowboy's defense for as long as the attack lasts.

pages.title: Arcade Car Drift
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Arcade Car Drift lets you choose from several cars and drive in two different environments. Steer into turns and use the handbrake to start slides. Practice controlling the car's direction and momentum as you drift through the available driving areas.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Hand Fracture
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Hand Fracture follows Hazel to the doctor after she hurts her hand in a fall. Help with the treatment, then care for her while the injured hand is in plaster. Assist with the everyday tasks she cannot manage alone during recovery.

pages.title: Maglu v2
pages.creator: Nicolas Tacgorian
pages.description: Maglu v2 sends you after an evil wizard who has stolen your pet. Jump through the route and shoot the threats blocking the rescue journey. Gather experience as you progress and use it to strengthen your skills and ability to survive further challenges.

pages.title: Zombie Apocalypse Quiz
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Zombie Apocalypse Quiz asks how you would handle an undead outbreak. Choose responses to the scenario questions and let the game combine your answers into a result. See the outcome assigned to your choices in its pop-culture-inspired survival questionnaire.

pages.title: Animal Trivia
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Animal Trivia tests your knowledge of wildlife through a series of questions. Select the answer you think is correct and check the additional information revealed afterward. Continue through the animal topics to see how many questions you can solve successfully.

pages.title: Toy Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Toy Cars Jigsaw offers twelve toy-vehicle pictures to rebuild. Select an easy 25-piece layout, a medium 49-piece one, or a hundred-piece challenge. Fit the scattered sections together until the full image of the chosen toy car is restored.

pages.title: Temple Escape
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Temple Escape sends a character through a route of obstacles and collectible coins. Turn and jump at the right moments to keep moving safely along the path. Use the coins collected during runs to unlock additional characters for another escape attempt.

pages.title: Africa Jeep Race
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Africa Jeep Race sends you across twelve dusty race routes against the computer or a friend. Choose a safari jeep, use power-ups, and compete to earn coins. Spend race winnings on additional vehicles before returning to the next driving challenge.

pages.title: Crazy Cutter
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Crazy Cutter asks you to keep chopping a tree while avoiding its branches. Tap to move the woodcutter to the correct side before the next cut. Keep the position changes timed correctly to protect the character and increase the chopping score.

pages.title: Garden Survive
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Garden Survive traps a cube-shaped character in a garden full of hazards. Dodge incoming razors, collapsing walls, and spiked wood as the challenge continues. Collect the health pickups that occasionally appear to gain another life and stay in the garden longer.

pages.title: Climbing Bird
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Climbing Bird challenges you to guide a bird upward between hazards along the sides of the route. Keep climbing through the gaps and collect gems as you rise. Reach higher floors to improve the bird's best ascent and open additional character options.

pages.title: Tank 1990
pages.creator: Yupi.io
pages.description: Tank 1990 recreates Battle City-style tank combat with keyboard controls. Drive the tank, fire at enemy armor, and defend your side of the battlefield. Keep the attackers from gaining ground while navigating the obstacles and shooting lanes in the arena.

pages.title: Sliding Puzzle Block Terror
pages.creator: Miau Studio Entertainment
pages.description: Sliding Puzzle Block Terror offers the familiar fifteen-tile rearrangement puzzle. Move tiles through the empty space and work out the sequence that restores their correct order. Plan several moves ahead so one misplaced section does not undo the progress elsewhere on the board.

pages.title: Tank Driver Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Tank Driver Simulator gives you two maps for practicing armored-vehicle control. Drive a tank through the environments and explore the different routes available. The city map also includes other vehicles, letting you change what you drive during the simulation session.

pages.title: Perfect Cake Master
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Perfect Cake Master lets you make a cake through a series of cooking activities. Follow the preparation steps and build the dessert using the choices provided by the game. Complete the cake-making process to finish your own version of the sweet treat.

pages.title: Pixel Bridge Builder
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Pixel Bridge Builder challenges you to extend a stick across gaps between platforms. Judge the distance before setting its length, since a bridge that falls short sends the character downward. Keep building accurate crossings to travel farther through the course.

pages.title: Magi Dogi
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Magi Dogi sends a magical dog through worlds threatened by evil forces. Use the character's wand and paw attacks to fight the enemies in the way. Travel across the magical land as you work toward driving out the powers disturbing its peace.

pages.title: Impossible Ski
pages.creator: wuqubGames
pages.description: Impossible Ski challenges you to keep a skier moving safely past obstacles. React to the hazards while collecting points throughout the run. Use the points you earn to unlock more characters and return to the slope for another attempt.

pages.title: Wonder Woman Face Care
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Wonder Woman Face Care asks you to help the heroine prepare before she heads out to save the world. Work through the facial-care activities to deal with her skin problems. Complete the treatment sequence so Wonder Woman is ready for her mission.

pages.title: Zayn Malik World Tour
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Zayn Malik World Tour puts you in charge of choosing the singer's stage looks during a tour. Browse the clothing and styling options to prepare outfits for his performances. Combine pieces into concert-ready appearances as you take on the role of his personal stylist.

pages.title: Princess Famous Tumblr Girl
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princess Famous Tumblr Girl gives you four princess styling sessions built around fashion looks. Browse dresses, change hairstyles, and combine the available accessories for each character. Finish the separate outfits to prepare the princesses for their Tumblr-inspired appearance.

pages.title: Crystal Gem Amethyst Dress Up
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Crystal Gem Amethyst Dress Up lets you style Amethyst before her next adventure with Steven and the Crystal Gems. Explore the clothing and appearance options available for the character. Put together a complete look for the purple gem using your chosen combinations.

pages.title: Classic Backgammon
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Classic Backgammon challenges you to move your checkers around the board and bear them off before the opponent. Choose a local match with a friend or face the computer. Plan the progress of your pieces as you work toward removing the full set.

pages.title: Tube Clicker
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Tube Clicker has you create a video channel and work toward increasing its audience. Manage the channel's growth and use advertising tools to attract views and subscribers. Continue expanding its reach as you build toward an audience numbering in the millions.

pages.title: Pinboard
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Pinboard challenges you to clear a board crowded with colored bubbles. Aim and shoot to remove the groups blocking the pinboard, choosing shots that open useful spaces. Keep working through the arrangement until every bubble has been cleared from the screen.

pages.title: Riley Bathroom Cleaning
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Riley Bathroom Cleaning gives you a dirty bathroom that needs washing, repairs, and tidying. Use the cleaning tools to deal with the toilet and the surrounding mess. Complete the household tasks to leave the bathroom in a cleaner, repaired condition.

pages.title: Princess Mannequin Challenge
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Mannequin Challenge joins Merida, Elsa, and Jasmine as they prepare a frozen-pose video, with Tiana filming. Help the princesses select outfits for their appearance in the challenge. Complete the group styling before they take their places for the recording.

pages.title: Mini Coloring Book
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Mini Coloring Book offers pages of character drawings for you to decorate. Browse the pictures and select colors to fill their different areas. Work through the book's illustrations and create your own palette for each of the characters shown.

pages.title: Basket Fall
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Basket Fall challenges you to drop a ball into a hoop with a well-timed tap. Watch its position and choose the release moment so it lands in the basket. Keep adjusting your timing as you work through the basketball-dropping challenge.
